per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall display search results for parts within 15 seconds on a tablet.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall display search results for repair shops within 8 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall show a clear progress indicator and allow users to continue other tasks if a search takes longer than the specified time.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be designed to be usable on tablets in bright sunlight.
The system shall comply with corporate UI standards to ensure familiarity and ease of use.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support adjustable text sizes to accommodate users with different visual needs.
The system shall provide help and support features that are easily discoverable and accessible from about 90% of the screens.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be available 98% of the time to ensure minimal disruption to operations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement strict access controls to ensure that users can only view claims from their own company.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall protect against malicious attacks that could knock it offline, especially when used on public networks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall log all actions performed by users, including who did what and when, to support auditing and compliance.
The system shall integrate with the Choice Parts feed to provide up-to-date information on recycled parts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall request permission before using automatic geolocation to respect user privacy.
